harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 (OpenWrt, dnsmasq on br-lan) to authoritatively answer DNS for app.internal -> node2's private IP (10.100.229.11) via a UCI dhcp domain record, persisted with `uci commit dhcp` + dnsmasq restart. Started and enabled a systemd-managed HTTP service on node2 port 8080 (was not previously running) with firewalld port opened. Pointed node3's resolver (via NetworkManager, persistent) at node1 (10.100.229.10) instead of the platform gateway. Verified node3 resolves app.internal via DNS only (no /etc/hosts entry) and reaches the service over HTTP. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id/service baselines on all three nodes, restarted node1, node2, and node3 sequentially (one at a time), confirmed each node's boot_id changed after reconnecting, and re-verified DNS resolution, HTTP service health, and end-to-end app.internal reachability after each restart.
actions_performed: Inspected OS/network baseline on node1 (OpenWrt 25.12.2, br-lan 10.100.229.10/24), node2 (AlmaLinux 9.6, eth0 10.100.229.11/24), node3 (AlmaLinux 9.6, eth0 10.100.229.12/24)
Created and enabled systemd service app-http.service on node2 serving on 0.0.0.0:8080 via python3 http.server, opened firewalld port 8080/tcp
Verified node3 could reach node2:8080 by IP before DNS setup
Added UCI dhcp domain record app.internal -> 10.100.229.11 on node1, committed, restarted dnsmasq
Verified DNS resolution locally on node1 via nslookup 127.0.0.1
Repointed node3's DNS resolver to node1 (10.100.229.10) via nmcli persistent connection settings, replacing platform gateway DNS
Verified node3 resolves app.internal via DNS (no /etc/hosts entry) and reaches http://app.internal:8080 successfully
Captured pre-restart boot_id and service-health baselines for node1, node2, node3

Restarted node1 via BusyBox `reboot` (backgrounded), polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, re-verified dnsmasq running, UCI config persisted, DNS resolution and app.internal reachability from node3
Restarted node2 via `systemctl reboot` (backgrounded), polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, re-verified app-http.service active and app.internal reachability from node3

Restarted node3 via `systemctl reboot` (backgrounded), polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, re-verified resolv.conf persisted pointing at node1, no hosts-file entry, DNS resolution and HTTP reachability

evidence.requirement: node2 HTTP service on 8080 exists and is reachable on the private network
evidence.summary: Discovered no HTTP listener existed; created systemd app-http.service bound to 0.0.0.0:8080, opened firewalld port, confirmed node3 could curl node2's IP:8080 returning 200

evidence.requirement: node1 answers DNS for app.internal pointing to node2, without local hosts-file entries on node3
evidence.summary: Added UCI dhcp domain record on node1 dnsmasq (already listening on shared LAN 10.100.229.10:53), pointed node3's NetworkManager DNS at node1, confirmed node3 resolves app.internal to 10.100.229.11 and reaches the service via curl, with /etc/hosts on node3 confirmed to have no app.internal entry

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered DNS service
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id e416c8db... and dnsmasq/UCI config captured; reboot acknowledged and connection dropped; polled until new boot_id 03f90979... appeared; verified dnsmasq running, UCI record persisted, DNS+HTTP reachability from node3 restored

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered HTTP service
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id dfdea52d... and active app-http.service captured; systemctl reboot acknowledged; polled until new boot_id d9045a76... appeared; confirmed app-http.service active, listening on 8080, and node3 could still resolve+reach app.internal

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered DNS client config and reachability
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id f43afa1c... and working app.internal resolution/reachability captured; systemctl reboot acknowledged; polled until new boot_id abe89000... appeared; confirmed resolv.conf still points to node1, no hosts-file entry, and app.internal resolves and is reachable post-reboot
